content.value_statement: Teams need clear choices for embedding models, chunking, and evaluation before building vector search. This skill provides practical templates and decision guidance for RAG and semantic retrieval.
actual_capabilities: Compares common embedding models by dimensions, token limits, and best-fit use cases.
Provides OpenAI and sentence-transformers embedding examples for batch and single text inputs.
Shows token, sentence, semantic section, and recursive chunking strategies.
Outlines domain-specific pipelines for document and code embeddings.
Defines retrieval quality metrics, including precision, recall, MRR, and NDCG.
limitations: It is a guide and does not execute embeddings or manage vector databases.
Model details may need verification against current provider documentation.
Examples require environment-specific testing before production use.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the scanned package.

use_cases.title: RAG Model Selection
use_cases.description: Compare hosted and local embedding options for accuracy, cost, and language requirements.

use_cases.title: Chunking Policy Design
use_cases.description: Choose chunk sizes, overlap, and semantic boundaries for documents before indexing.

use_cases.title: Retrieval Evaluation Planning
use_cases.description: Define precision, recall, MRR, and NDCG checks for search quality reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Embedding Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner selection for a new retrieval project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose an embedding model for [content type], [languages], [budget], and [latency target]. Compare tradeoffs and recommend one option.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Chunking Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a chunking strategy for [document type] with [average length], [retrieval goal], and [token limit]. Include size, overlap, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Build a RAG Embedding Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation plan for a RAG embedding pipeline using [provider], [vector database], and [metadata fields]. Include batching, preprocessing, and cache decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Retrieval Quality
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced assessment after indexing or model changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an evaluation plan for [query set] and [relevance labels]. Include metrics, sampling, failure analysis, and acceptance thresholds.

output_examples.input: Need embeddings for English support articles with low cost.
output_examples.output: Recommended text-embedding-3-small, batched requests, normalized vectors, and recall testing against common support queries.
Use semantic section chunking with moderate overlap, preserve headers, and store document identifiers as metadata.

output_examples.input: Search quality dropped after a model change.
output_examples.output: Run side-by-side evaluation with precision, recall, MRR, and NDCG before replacing the existing embedding index.

best_practices: Match the embedding model to content type, language coverage, and latency needs.
Preserve semantic boundaries when chunking long documents.
Evaluate retrieval quality before and after model or chunking changes.
anti_patterns: Mixing embedding models in the same vector index without migration planning.
Ignoring token limits and allowing important context to be truncated.
Skipping preprocessing, normalization, and retrieval validation.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps choose embedding models, design chunking, and evaluate vector search quality.

faq.question: Does it run embedding jobs?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples that users must adapt and test.

faq.question: Can it support local embedding models?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes sentence-transformers examples and local model selection guidance.

faq.question: Is it only for RAG systems?
faq.answer: No. It also applies to semantic search, document clustering, and similarity workflows.

faq.question: Does it cover evaluation metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers precision, recall, MRR, NDCG, and similarity comparisons.

faq.question: Should model details be verified?
faq.answer: Yes. Provider limits, dimensions, and pricing can change over time.
